race.description: Noel Comerford’s Auto Parts/Accessories Mdn Hcp
race.comment: HELLFIGHTER (3) didn't fire in his stable debut at the Sapphire Coast when he was almost too bad to be true. Blinkers come off now and Keatings sticks. Worth another look. BRILLIANT BULL ANT (7) never looked likely last time at Wodonga in the slop when always well back. Had been savaging the line prior and was knocking on the door. Can forgive, watch for him charging late. NIKITA ZOU (8) is close to breaking through, last start finishing full of running to just fall a head away in second over this trip at Nowra. Has further improvement in store and can fight out the finish. EL COOL GEE (11) has hit the line nicely in her first two starts and is open to further improvement. Don't underestimate.
